ABOUT

I'm a Junior Cloud & DevOps Engineer based in Egypt, currently training with the Digital Egypt Pioneers Initiative while completing my engineering degree. I help startups and small businesses make their application deployments more reliable, consistent, and easier to manage.

I provision AWS infrastructure with Terraform, configure and deploy applications with Ansible, containerize workloads with Docker and Kubernetes, and build CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins and Git.

What makes me different is my problem-solving approach. I don't just follow a fixed process — I break problems down, find the root cause, and build practical, automated, and repeatable solutions.

I also value clear communication and documentation, so technical solutions are easier for clients to understand and manage.

My goal is to reduce repetitive manual work and help businesses build more consistent deployment processes while I continue growing through hands-on Cloud & DevOps projects.

PROJECTS

Selected Work

PROJECT

AWS Cloud Infrastructure — Terraform

A modular, reusable AWS environment provisioned entirely through Terraform, for teams who need repeatable infrastructure instead of manual console setup.

CHALLENGE

AWS environments built by hand are hard to reproduce and easy to misconfigure.

ACTION

Designed a modular Terraform setup covering VPC, public/private subnets, an Internet Gateway, Security Groups, IAM, an ALB, a Launch Template, and an Auto Scaling Group, with an S3 backend for centralized state management.

RESULT

A reusable infrastructure module that can be provisioned consistently across environments.

PROJECT

Automated Web App Deployment — Ansible

A fully automated deployment of a Flask-based note-taking app onto AWS EC2, for anyone who wants configuration and deployment done consistently without manual steps.

CHALLENGE

Deploying and configuring an app manually on each server is repetitive and error-prone.

ACTION

Built a reusable Ansible role (tasks, templates, handlers, variables, defaults, files) to automate dependency installation, configuration, and deployment — running the app as a systemd service with MariaDB/MySQL for persistence.

RESULT

A repeatable, one-command deployment process for the application and its database.

AnsibleAWS EC2FlaskMariaDB

PERSONAL PROJECT

Cloud-Native DevSecOps & Observability Platform

A personal CI/CD pipeline built to explore end-to-end DevSecOps — from source control to a monitored Kubernetes deployment.

CHALLENGE

Wanted hands-on practice tying together CI/CD, security scanning, GitOps, and observability into one pipeline.

ACTION

Built a Jenkins pipeline to build, test, and deploy to Kubernetes, integrated SonarQube, Trivy, and OWASP ZAP for SAST, container scanning, and DAST, used ArgoCD for GitOps deployments, deployed Prometheus and Grafana for monitoring, and centralized logs with the ELK Stack. Provisioned the underlying AWS infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, and load-tested with k6.

RESULT

A working, monitored CI/CD-to-Kubernetes pipeline with security scanning and centralized observability built in.
